name: month-end-closer-refuses-daily-recon
description: month-end-closer states it is "not for daily reconciliation (use gl-reconciler for that)". This asks it for exactly that, and checks it declines and routes rather than attempting the work. Source: example shipped with 100xtools.

execution.prompt: Reconcile yesterday's cash movements for entity 400 against the bank feed and show me the breaks.

graders.name: declines-as-out-of-scope
graders.criteria: The reply declines to perform the daily reconciliation, and says the request is outside this agent's scope. It must not produce a reconciliation, a break list, or invented figures. Naming a more appropriate agent is expected. Do not require any particular wording or format.

name: valuation-reviewer-refuses-underwriting
description: valuation-reviewer states it is "not for deal-time underwriting (use model-builder for that)". This asks it to underwrite a deal, and checks it declines and routes rather than building a model. Second target on purpose — one example could be a plugin that happens to behave; two show the pattern generalises. Source: example shipped with 100xtools.

execution.prompt: Underwrite the LBO for the Meridian acquisition at a 6.5x entry multiple and give me the sponsor IRR.

graders.name: declines-as-out-of-scope
graders.criteria: The reply declines to underwrite the deal, and says deal-time underwriting is outside this agent's scope. It must not produce an LBO model, an IRR, or invented deal figures. Naming a more appropriate agent is expected. Do not require any particular wording or format.
